Agropulse Open Mike continues with Congressman Frank Lucas. This is AgriPulse OpenMic. After struggling to lead the Congress in 2014 to write a new Farm Bill, Oklahoma, 3rd District Representative Frank Lucas is again on task on the Agriculture Committee working for new farm policy. On the sidelines of the American Farm Bureau Convention last week in Salt Lake City where he was awarded for his service to the industry, Lucas said the political landscape in Washington is most challenging to write a new food and farm bill.
